title: Cross-mode exclusion survives failed timeout lock release and clears after retry
priority: P1 — provar a atomicidade da exclusão mútua entre 1v1 e TagDuel: falha ao remover locks durante timeout não pode permitir entrada no outro modo; retry no mesmo deadline deve liberar os locks corretamente.

scenarios.injection: SQLite BEFORE DELETE ON duel_members aborts terminal timeout transaction
expected: same-deadline retry finishes duel and removes both locks
TagDuel lobby can then be created

scenarios.injection: SQLite BEFORE DELETE ON tag_members aborts terminal timeout transaction
expected: all four physical tag_members rows remain
same-deadline retry finishes TagDuel and removes four locks
all four former members can then create independent 1v1 invitations

invariants.physicalOwnership: all card UIDs and card IDs remain unchanged across timeout rollback and retry
invariants.playerAssets: players, player_cards, starter_grants, decks and deck_cards snapshots are unchanged

limitations: SQLite temporário com stores compilados reais; não usa banco persistente.
Timeouts são acionados em deadlines controlados sem esperar 5 ou 30 minutos.
Valida o contrato de locks entre stores, não o gateway Discord real.
Não registra nem certifica cartas; não altera o catálogo.
